introduction.aboutTheseTerms: Tiwtilin Timatutin n Useqdec-a ('Tiwtilin') d agatu asadufan imsetlel gar-ak ('Aseqdac', 'kečč', neɣ 'inek') d Podacium SARL ('Podacium', 'nekni', neɣ 'nneɣ'), d takebbanit s tmasit talemmast (SARL) yettwajerrden deg Lezzayer.
introduction.acceptanceOfTerms: S unekcum, tunigin, ajerred, neɣ aseqdec n tenfalit d yimeẓla n Podacium (s umata, 'Tanfalit'), teqqreḍ dakken teɣriḍ, tegziḍ, yerna teqbleḍ ad tettwasikled s Tiwtilin-a, akk d Tsertit-nneɣ n Tbaḍnit, Tasertit n Inagan n Tuqqna, d Tsertit n Urrad, yellan d amur seg ugatu-a.
introduction.acceptanceWarning: Ma yella ur teqbileḍ ara Tiwtilin-a, ilaq ad teḥbseḍ imira aseqdec n Tenfalit.
introduction.amendments: Neḥrez azerfan ad nbeddel Tiwtilin-a deg yal akud. Ibeddilen ixataren ad ttwaceyɛen i yiseqdacen yettwajerrden s e-mail neɣ s walɣut afessas ɣef Tenfalit ma drus 15 n wussan uqbel ad bdun. Aseqdec-ik ikemmlen n Tenfalit deffir yibeddilen-a yettwaḥsab d aqbal n Tiwtilin timaynutin.
introduction.legalContinuity: Podacium SARL tezmer ad tbeddel talɣa-s tasadufant ɣer Tkebbanit s Yiswiren Ifessasen (SPAS) deg yimal. Asnifel-a ur yetteqqas ara azal neɣ aselkem n Tiwtilin-a. Iseqdacen ad ttwalɣen ɣef yal abeddel deg talɣa tasadufant.

definitions.intro: Ilmend n Tiwtilin-a, tisbadutin-a d tid yeqqnen:

eligibility.ageRequirements: I wakken ad tesnulfuḍ Amiḍan deg Podacium, ilaq ad tesɛuḍ ma drus 16 n yiseggasen. Iseqdacen gar 16 d 18 n yiseggasen zemren ad kecmen ɣer Tenfalit kan s tisurag n yimawlan neɣ n wemḍebber asadufan, ilmend n usaḍuf azzayri yellan.
eligibility.parentalConsentItem1: Amraw neɣ umḍebber asadufan ilaq ad d-yefk tisurag s usentem n tmagit
eligibility.parentalConsentItem2: Podacium teḥrrez ttbut n tsuragt n yimawlan deg tɣellist i usenqed d usnimer
eligibility.parentalConsentItem3: Imawlan neɣ yemḍebbren zemren ad kksen tisurag deg yal akud s unermis-nneɣ
eligibility.accountRegistration: I unekcum ɣer tmahilin timaddanin n Tenfalit, ilaq ad tesnulfuḍ Amiḍan s usuffeɣ n yisem-ik amakku, tansa e-mail tameɣtut, azemz n tlalit, d wawal n uffir yettṣadan d yisuturen-nneɣ n tɣellist.
eligibility.accountSecurity: D kečč i d amasay ɣef uḥerrez n tbaḍnit n yisallen n unekcum ɣer Umiḍan-ik d akk irmad i d-yeḍran ddaw-as. Ilaq ad aɣ-d-telɣuḍ imira ma tella tuffɣa ur nettusureg ara neɣ aṛebbi n tɣellist.
eligibility.accountTypes: Podacium teqbel Imiḍanen n Yinelmaden Udmawanen, Imiḍanen n Yililelliyen, Imiḍanen n Tnezzutin, d Yimiḍanen n Tuddsiwin, yal yiwen s tmahilin d yisuturen-is.

services.educationalServices: Podacium tettekkef imeẓla n ulmad s uselkim gar-asen timsiros n tvidyut yettwasekelsen, irmad imiriyen, ibriden n ulmad, iselkinen n taggara, ifaylan PDF, d uselmed s IA mi yewjed.
services.certificatesAndCredentials: Iselkinen i d-tettak Podacium skanayen-d aselkem n yisuturen n tmesrit lameɛna mačči d idublumen isdawiyen unsiben neɣ d iselkinen yettwaqeblen s wudem amaddud. D inagan ur nelli ara d unziben i usedmer n ulmad amezzayan.
services.aiServices: Podacium tezmer ad tesseqdec tatiknulujit n IA i usnerni n tirmit n ulmad. Timahilin n IA g仁asent iselmaden imeslayanen, isumaren udmawanen, asenqed awurman, d yifecka n usnulfu n ugbur. Igdalen ixataren llan ɣef ugbur isnulfa IA.
services.biFeatures: Podacium tettak-d ifecka n tesleḍt n BI i yiseqdacen udmawanen (tifelwin n usnerni n ulmad, tisleḍtin n tmahilt) d yiseqdacen n tnezzut/tuddsa (tisleḍtin n ulmad n yixeddamen, tifelwin n terbaɛt, ineqqisen udmawanen).

responsibilities.licenseToUse: Ilmend n uqader n Tiwtilin-a, Podacium tettak-ak tasuret talemmast, tar-tasligant, ur nettwasiweḍ ara, yezmer ad tettwakkes i unekcum d useqdec n Tenfalit i yiswiyen udmawanen neɣ n tnezzut taflayt.
responsibilities.permittedUses: Tzemreḍ ad tkecmeḍ ɣer tmesras i deg tjerrdeḍ, ad tettekkid deg yiseqqamen n Tenfalit, ad tesnulfeḍ Agbur n Useqdac ilmend n Tiwtilin-a, ad tesseqdceḍ timahilin n BI i tesleḍt tameɣtut, yerna ad tessidreḍ ifaylan yettusurgen i usider.
responsibilities.prohibitedUses: Ur ilaq ara ad tesseqdceḍ Tanfalit i yiswiyen ur nelli ara deg usaḍuf, ad tettekkid deg txazabit n ulmad, ad tebḍuḍ isallen n Umiḍan, ad tɛawdeḍ tasleḍt n unagraw n Tenfalit, ad tesseqdceḍ inagrawen iwurmanen i ujemmeɛ n yisefka, ad tzegleḍ inagrawen n uxlas, ad tsaliḍ tangalt tucmit, ad tcewweleḍ iseqdacen wiyaḍ, ad tseqdceḍ tamagit n wiyaḍ, neɣ ad tcewweleḍ Imeẓla n IA.

intellectualProperty.ourIP: Akk Agbur n Tenfalit, gar-as tangalt n uẓar, isnasen, ilugritmen, ifaylan n tmesras, imeddulen n IA, udem n Tenfalit, ticraḍ n tnezzut, iluguten, d yifecka n Business Intelligence, d ayla n Podacium SARL neɣ s tsuragt n wid n berra. Akk izerfan ttwawḥan.
intellectualProperty.userContentOwnership: Tḥerrzeḍ ayla-ik amakku ɣef Agbur Isnulfa Useqdac i d-tesnulfaḍ, gar-asen imahilen n tmesras, iznan deg yiseqqamen, ticekkiyin, d wayen i d-tessewjdeḍ deg umahil ilelli.
intellectualProperty.licenseToPodacium: S tuffɣa n Ugbur Isnulfa Useqdac ɣer Tenfalit, tettakeḍ-as i Podacium tasuret tar-tasligant, tamadlant, baṭel, yezmer ad tettwasureg d usedmer i usken, asenɣel, d usedger n ugbur-ik ɣef Tenfalit.

payments.pricing: Azalen n tmesras, ijerriḍen, d tmettiwin n Ulzuz n Yililelliyen ttwaskanen deg Tenfalit s Yidinaren Izzayriyen (DZD) neɣ s tedrimin niḍen yellan. Azalen zemren ad beddlen deg yal akud.
payments.paymentMethods: Podacium teqbel ixlasen s tewwura n uxlas n wid n berra yettwasurgen, gar-asent tikarḍiwin tibankiyin tizzayriyin (CIB, EDAHABIA), anagraw n uxlas SATIM, d yimseddiyen n uxlas imaḍlanen yettwasurgen.
payments.taxes: Azalen yettwaskanen sɛan deg-sen tazeṭṭaṭ tazzayrit (TVA) anagar ma yella wayen nniḍen i d-yettwannan. Iseqdacen imaḍlanen zemren ad selsen tizeṭṭaḍin n tmurt-nsen.
payments.refundPolicy: Tiwtilin telqayen n urrad llan deg Tsertit-nneɣ n Urrad tasligant. Gar-asent: urrad amakku deg 7 n wussan i tiɣin n tmesrit ma ur yelli wugbur yettwaɣren, urrad amurran i usedmer amurran, d tegnatin ur nettwarad ara.

dataProtection.privacyCommitment: Podacium teqqen iman-is i uḥerrez n yisefka-ik udmawanen ilmend n Usaḍuf Azzayri uṭṭun 18-07 ɣef Uḥerrez n Yisefka Udmawanen. Talqayt tamaddut tella deg Tsertit-nneɣ n Tbaḍnit.
dataProtection.userRights: Tesɛiḍ azerfan ad tawḍeḍ ɣer yisefka-ik udmawanen, ad tesseggmeḍ isefka ur nseḥḥa ara, ad tekseḍ isefka-ik (ilmend n yisuturen n usaḍuf), ad tgdeleḍ kra n yirmad n uselkem, ad tekseḍ tisurag n uselkem ur nelli d afrayan, yerna ad tcekkfeḍ ɣer Tanbaḍt Taɣelnawt i Uḥerrez n Yisefka Udmawanen (ANPDP).
dataProtection.dataRetention: Isefka udmawanen ttwakksen 6 n wagguren deffir tukksa n Umiḍan. Isekra n tedrimt ttwassumren 10 n yiseggasen s wudem ur nettwassen ara. Iselkinen n taggara n tmesras ttwassumren i lebda i usenqed.

thirdParty.integrations: Podacium teqqen d yimeẓla n wid n berra gar-asen imseddiyen n uxlas, imḍebbren n IA, ifecka n tesleḍt, imukan n usider deg usigna, d yimeẓla n teywalt. Imeẓla-a sɛan tiwtilin d tsertiyin-nsen n tbaḍnit.
thirdParty.liability: Podacium tettheggi akk tazmert-is i wakken ad textir imḍebbren ifazen. Lameɛna, ur nelli ara d imasayen ɣef wuguren, aḥbas, neɣ tuccḍiwin n yimeẓla n wid n berra. Nḥerrez inagrawen n uḥraz anida yella wamek s tniknikt.

disclaimers.educationalDisclaimer: Podacium ur tettḍaman ara dakken akfa n tmesras ad d-yawi igmad n ulmad usligen, amahil, dduzan n tesdawit, neɣ tasuragt tamsadurt. Afara n ulmad yettkel ɣef tezmert tudmawant d tegnatin uffiɣin sennig tezmert-nneɣ.
disclaimers.aiDisclaimer: Imeẓla n IA zemren ad d-fken isallen ur nseḥḥa ara, ur nkemmil ara, neɣ iɣellḍen. Isumaren n IA d tinaḍin timatutin kan yerna mačči d asiwel amsadur. Nermes imusnawen i yiseftiyen ixataren.
disclaimers.limitationOfLiability: Alamma d afellay yettusurgen ddaw usaḍuf azzayri, Podacium ur telli ara d tamasayt ɣef lixsas arusrid, amuran, neɣ amsedrar. Ma yella Podacium tettwaḥseb d tamasayt, tamasit-nneɣ tamatut teḥbes ɣef wazal yettwaxelsen deg 12 n wagguren iɛeddan neɣ 50,000 n Yidinaren Izzayriyen (DZD), d win meẓẓiyen gar-asen.

forceMajeure.intro: Podacium ur telli ara d tamasayt ɣef lmeṭla neɣ urkisen n uselkem n yigaten ilmend n tadyanin sennig tezmert-nneɣ, gar-asent lmuṣibat tigmamin, aṭṭanen imeqqranen, imenɣiyen, tigawin n unabaḍ, lexsas n uẓeṭṭa n Internet, tawaɣiyin talyiktruniyin, uguren n yiseddayen n wid n berra, aḥbas n yixeddamen, neɣ akfay n trisiti.

termination.byUser: Tzemreḍ ad tekseḍ Amiḍan-ik deg yal akud s tqeffalt n tukksa deg yiɣewwaren n Umiḍan neɣ s unermis n tallelt. Agmu n tukksa yesɛa deg-s aḥbas imira n unekcum, tukksa n yisefka udmawanen deg 6 n wagguren, d uḥerrez n yisekra n tedrimt i 10 n yiseggasen.
termination.byPodacium: Nezmer ad neḥbes neɣ ad nṛecc Amiḍan-ik imira war alɣu ɣef uṛebbi ameqqran n Tiwtilin (txazabit, irmad ur nelli deg usaḍuf, acewwel, tukksa n teyla, takerḍa n ulmad, neɣ asenqes n tɣellist n Tenfalit).

disputeResolution.governingLaw: Tiwtilin-a ttwanebḍent yerna ttwafsrent ilmend n yisuḍaf n Lezzayer, gar-asen Asaḍuf 18-07 ɣef Uḥerrez n Yisefka Udmawanen, Asaḍuf 18-05 ɣef Tnezzut Talyiktrunit, Asaḍuf 09-03 ɣef Uḥerrez n Umsaɣ, d Yikatan Izzayriyen n Umdan d Tnezzut.
disputeResolution.jurisdiction: Yal amyenaqef i d-yekkan seg neɣ yeqqnen ɣer Tiwtilin-a neɣ aseqdec-ik n Tenfalit ad yettwazen kan ɣer tsenbaḍin n Wehran, Lezzayer.
disputeResolution.adr: Uqbel abdu n ukala deg tsenbeḍt, iḥricen qeblen ad ɛerḍen tifrat s umeslay n liser (30 n wussan) d umsuqqel sɣur umsuqqel yettwaqeblen deg Lezzayer. ADR ur yettheggi ara yiwen seg yexsimen ad yessuter tasertit taruradt n tsenbeḍt.

generalProvisions.entireAgreement: Tiwtilin-a, akk d Tsertit n Tbaḍnit, Tasertit n Inagan n Tuqqna, d Tsertit n Urrad, d agatu amakku gar-ak d Podacium ɣef useqdec n Tenfalit, yessurfen akk agaten d yigiman yezwaren.
generalProvisions.language: Tiwtilin-a ttwuran s Teglizit. Lqem unzib s Taɛrabt ad yeffeɣ d lqem asadufan amenzu. Mi d-yeffeɣ, lqem n Taɛrabt ad yuɣal d win imsetlen s usaḍuf. Ma yella umgired gar yisuqqilen, lqem unzib s Taɛrabt i d amenzu.

introduction.ourCommitment: Podacium SARL ('Podacium', 'nekni', neɣ 'nneɣ') teqqen iman-is i uḥerrez n tbaḍnit d yisefka udmawanen n akk iseqdacen n tenfalit-nneɣ n ulmad ('Tanfalit'). Tasertit-a n Tbaḍnit tessefhem-d amek i d-njemmeɛ, nseqdac, nḥerrez, nebṭu, yerna nḥemmel isallen-ik udmawanen ilmend n Usaḍuf Azzayri uṭṭun 18-07 n 10 Yunyu 2018 ɣef Uḥerrez n Yisefka Udmawanen ('Asaḍuf 18-07').

introduction.regulatoryCompliance: Podacium teqqen iman-is i usnimer d: Usaḍuf Azzayri 18-07 ɣef Uḥerrez n Yisefka Udmawanen, Ilugan n Tanbaḍt Taɣelnawt i Uḥerrez n Yisefka Udmawanen (ANPDP), Ikataren imaḍlanen n uḥerrez n yisefka. Nejred (neɣ ad nejred uqbel aznuz amaddud) akk aselken n uselkem n yisefka d ANPDP yerna ad d-nawi tisurag ilaqen i usiweḍ n yisefka sennig tlisa.
introduction.relationshipToPolicies: Tasertit-a n Tbaḍnit ilaq ad tettwaɣer akk d: Tiwtilin n Useqdec (yeṭṭfen tisekkirin n uqbal deg Uḥric 7.8), Tasertit n Inagan n Tuqqna (yeṭṭfen talqayt ɣef useqdec n yinagan d uḍfar), Tasertit n Urrad.

introduction.policyExplanation: Tasertit-a n Inagan n Tuqqna tessefhem-d amek i tesseqdac Podacium SARL ('Podacium,' 'nekni,' neɣ 'nneɣ') inagan n tuqqna d tatiknulujit n uḍfar yettemcabin ɣef usmel d tenfalit-nneɣ (s umata, 'Tanfalit'). introduction.complianceCommitment: Neqqen iman-nneɣ i uḥerrez n tbaḍnit-ik d usedmer n tsedmirt deg tarrayin-nneɣ n yisefka s uqader amakku n Usaḍuf Azzayri uṭṭun 18-07 n 10 Yunyu 2018 ɣef Uḥerrez n Yisefka Udmawanen.

whatAreCookies.definition: Inagan n tuqqna d ifaylan imecṭaḥ n uḍris yettwasersen ɣef wallal-ik (aselkim, tatablett, neɣ aziraz) mi ara trezfeḍ asmel web. Ttwaseqdacen aṭas i wakken ismal ad qedcen s tezmert, ad cfoun ɣef yisnisen-ik, yerna ad fken isallen i bab n yismel.
whatAreCookies.trackingTechnologies: Nseqdac daɣen tatiknulujit n uḍfar yettemcabin am web beacons, pixels, d uḥraz adigan (yettwasemman s umata 'inagan n tuqqna' deg tsertit-a).

introduction.policyExplanation: Tasertit-a n Urrad tnebbed akk isuturen n urrad ɣef yifarisen d yimeẓla yettwaɣen deg tenfalit n Podacium, yettwaselken sɣur Podacium SARL, d takebbanit s tmasit talemmast yettwajerrden deg Lezzayer.

introduction.multiPillarEcosystem: Podacium tesɛa anagraw ameqqran umḍin yesɛan Tanfalit n Ulmad (timsiros s uselkim, ibriden n ulmad), Imeẓla n Ujerred (isurifen n Yinelmaden, anekcum ɣer Business Intelligence), Ulzuz n Yililelliyen (imeẓla yebnan ɣef yisenfaren s wazalen n tmahilin), d Unagraw n Tsaqayt Tumḍint (aselkem n uxlas s PodaPoints d tiɣin n tmahilin).
introduction.relationshipToTerms: Tasertit-a n Urrad d amur seg Tiwtilin n Useqdec n Podacium. Ma yella umgired gar Tsertit-a d Tiwtilin, d Tasertit-a ara iḥekkmen deg temsal n urrad.

generalPrinciples.digitalContentBarrier: Mi ara yettwaɣer ugbur umḍin (tavidyut tettwali, afaylu yettwasider, akayad yettwaxdem, tazwart tekfa), yettwaḥseb d win yewwḍen yerna yettwaseqdec. Ulac urrad ɣef ugbur yettwaɣren anagar ma yella lixsas ameqqran deg-s neɣ ur yemṣada ara d uglam.
generalPrinciples.servicePerformance: Imeẓla n tenfalit (anekcum ɣer tseddast, aselkem n uxlas, tuqqna gar yiseqdacen, tifrat n yimyenqafen) mgaraden ɣef ugbur neɣ yifarisen yettwaɣen. Izaɣaren n yimeẓla ɣef tmahilin yermden ur ttwarraden ara mi ara qedcen, ɣas aseqdac ur yeɛǧib-it ara ugmu.
generalPrinciples.consumerProtection: Ulac ayen deg Tsertit-a n Urrad ara yekksen neɣ ara yessenqsen izerfan-ik ilaqen ddaw Usaḍuf Azzayri 09-03 ɣef Uḥerrez n Umsaɣ (yettwabeddlen s Usaḍuf 18-09), gar-asen azerfan-ik ɣer yisallen iseḥḥan, imeẓla n tɣara deg tɣellist, aseggem n yimeẓla yesɛan lixsas, d usekcem n tcekkift ɣer yiduba n uḥerrez n umsaɣ.
generalPrinciples.withdrawalRight: Ddaw usaḍuf azzayri n umsaɣ (Asaḍuf 09-03), imsaɣen sɛan azerfan n uḥebbus n 14 n wussan i yigaten n lebɛid. Lameɛna, ilmend n usurif n ugbur umḍin (Tasreft 4 n Tanaḍt Taslekmant 14-134), teqbleḍ s wudem afessas anekcum imira yerna tettedduḍ azerfan-ik n uḥebbus mi ara yekfu usedmer n ugbur umḍin (tamsirt tettwaɣer, tavidyut tettwali, neɣ aselkin yeffeɣ-d). Tanzayt-nneɣ n urrad n 7 n wussan tugar tanzayt tadrusant n usaḍuf i tɣara n ugbur umḍin, yerna azerfan n 14 n wussan ur yettseqdac ara mi ara tessutreḍ aselkem uqbel ad tfak tanzayt n uḥebbus.

educationRefunds.individualCourse7Day: Tzemreḍ ad tessutreḍ urrad amakku i tiɣin n tmesrit tudmawant deg 7 n wussan n tiɣin ma yella: Ur teɣriḍ ara agbur n tmesrit (0% n usnerni), Ulac aselkin i d-yeffɣen, Asuter yettwaceyyeɛ s yiberdan unziben.

paymentProcessing.currency: Iseqdacen izzayriyen: Akk tinezzutin d wurraden s Yidinaren Izzayriyen (DZD). Iseqdacen imaḍlanen: Urraden s tedrimt tamezwarut n tnezzut ilmend n wazal amezwaru. Isefra n tenfalit ttwattunefken s DZD i akk iseqdacen.
paymentProcessing.taxHandling: Akk azalen sɛan deg-sen Tazeṭṭaṭ ɣef Wazan Amernan (TVA) ilmend n wazal amiran deg Lezzayer. Urraden sɛan deg-sen TVA yettwaxelsen ɣef wazal yettwarraden. Podacium tettak-d tanaḍt n uselken (note de crédit) i akk urraden i usnimer asadufan.

platformCredits.creditBonus: I yisuturen n urrad yettwaqeblen, Podacium tezmer ad d-tsumer isefra n Tenfalit d tasentit i tedrimt s yimuren imernanen: 110% n wazal amernan i wurraden yettusutren s usaḍuf neɣ tsertit, 120% n wazal amernan i wurraden n tmuɣli tusligt.
platformCredits.creditTerms: Isefra n Tenfalit: Qeddcen i 12 n wagguren seg tuffɣa, Zemren ad ttwaseqdacen i tiɣin n tmesras, ijerriḍen, imeẓla n yililelliyen, Zemren ad ttwasedmren d tarzeft i wiyaḍ, Ur zemren ara ad uɣalen d tadrimt, Kfan tizi-nsen deffir 12 n wagguren.
platformCredits.userChoice: Isefra d afrayanen yal tikelt. Tzemreḍ ad ten-tugiḍ yerna ad tawiḍ tuɣalin n tedrimt tagamant (war amur amernan).

fraudPrevention.abuseIndicators: Podacium teḥrez azerfan ad tagi urrad yerna ad teḥbes Imiḍanen ɣef usedder amsedrar gar-as: Ugar n 2 n yisuturen n urrad deg 6 n wagguren, Isuturen n urrad ɣef ugar n 30% n tiɣin tamatut, Aɣuri ɛlayen n ugbur uqbel asuter n urrad.
fraudPrevention.largeRefundVerification: Urraden yugaren 10,000 DZD ḥwaǧen asenqed n tmagit i uqader n yilugan izzayriyen mgal asired n tedrimt, ikataren n useddel n txazabit, d yisuturen n usnimer n tzeṭṭaḍin.
fraudPrevention.chargebackPolicy: Tukksa n uxlas tameɣtut (tanezzut ur nettusureg ara, tuccḍa n ufeter, ameẓlu ur yewwiḍ ara): Podacium teqbel-itt. Tukksa n uxlas n txazabit (ameẓlu yewweḍ yerna yettwaseqdec): Podacium tezmer ad temcici, ad teḥbes Amiḍan, ad tgdel tarrayin n uxlas, yerna ad teddu ɣer tsenbeḍt.
fraudPrevention.chargebackFees: Asuter n tukksa n uxlas ɣer lbanka yekkes azerfan-ik ɣer urrad agaman. Nermes tallelt uqbel lbanka-ik. Aṭas n wuguren zemren ad frun s urured s umeslay usrid.

specialCases.giftPurchases: I tmesras neɣ ijerriḍen yettwaɣen d tarzeft: D win i d-yuɣen kan i yezmren ad yessuter urrad, Ilmend n tegnatin tigamanin n urrad, Win yewwin tarzeft ur yesɛi ara azerfan ɣer wurrad.
specialCases.duplicatePurchases: Tiɣin yettwalsen s tuccḍa: Nermes-aɣ-d deg 48 n tsaɛatin n tiɣin, Efk-d uṭṭunen n tnezzutin, Urrad amakku ad yettunefk i tiɣin tis snat deg 3-5 n wussan n umahil.
specialCases.accountDeletion: Isuturen n tukksa n Umiḍan: Urrad amurran yella kan i tanzayin n ujerred ur nettwaseqdec ara deffir 30 n wussan n leɛmer adrusi, Ulac urrad ɣef tiɣin n tmesras tudmawanin, Tadrimt n tsaqayt tezmer ad tettwazen ɣer umiḍan n lbanka.
specialCases.deceasedUsers: Imiḍanen n wid yemmuten: Imasladen n twacult yettwasurgen zemren ad ssutren urrad i yijerriḍen urmeden d tedrimt n tsaqayt, Ifaylan yettusutren: afaylu n tmettant, tasuragt tasadufant, ttbut n wassaɣ n twacult.
specialCases.promotionalPurchases: Tiɣin s wazalen n usnuzer: Urraden ttwasiḍnen ilmend n wazal yettwaxelsen s tidet (azal yersan), mačči azal amezwaru amakku, Tangalt n usedmer ur tettwarad ara s yiman-is.
specialCases.bundleUpgrades: Asali n uswir n ujerred: Ulac urrad amurran i wakud ur nettwaseqdec ara n uswir yersan, Azal n usali yettwasiḍen d amgired gar yiswiren yettwasiḍnen i wakud i d-yegran deg tanzayt.

items: Tafelwit n Tenfalit (Iɣewwaren n Umiḍan → Amezruy n Tiɣin)

procedures.requiredInformation: Akk isuturen n urrad ilaq ad sɛun: Uṭṭun n tnezzut neɣ n usuter, Tansa e-mail n Umiḍan, Azemz n tiɣin, Isem n ufaris/umeẓlu, Sebba telqayt n urrad, Ttbut ifazen (ma yella).
procedures.processingTimeline: Asentem: 24-48 n tsaɛatin, Tasleḍt d usefti: 3-5 n wussan n umahil, Asenqed iweɛren: 7-14 n wussan n umahil, Aselkem n urrad: 5-10 n wussan n umahil ɣer tarrayt n uxlas.
procedures.statusTracking: Ḍfer addad n urrad s: Ilɣuten n e-mail, Aḥric n Umezruy n Urrad deg Tfelwit n Umiḍan, Ibeddilen deg unagraw n tinfulin n tallelt.

disputeResolution.internalAppeals: Ma yettwagi usuter n urrad: Ceyyeɛ asuter n wallus deg 14 n wussan s e-mail, Rnu uṭṭun n tansa d usefhem alqayan, Amselkam amezwaru ad isenqed asuter, Asfti aneggaru deg 7 n wussan n umahil.
disputeResolution.externalResolution: Ma ur teqdaceḍ ara d usuter agensan: Cektef ɣer Tenmehla Tamatut n Tnezzut (DGC), Nermes Tanbaḍt Taɣelnawt i Uḥerrez n Yisefka Udmawanen (ANPDP) i yimyenqafen n yisefka, Ddu ɣer tsenbaḍin tizzayriyin.
disputeResolution.voluntaryMediation: Uqbel abdu deg tsenbeḍt, iḥricen zemren ad qblen amsuqqel n liser: Fren amsuqqel yettwaqeblen s wuzzul, Azalen ad bḍun s tegdut, Taggara deg 30-45 n wussan, Ur yettḥettim ara anagar ma qblen iḥricen i sin.

policyUpdates.rightToModify: Podacium teḥrez azerfan ad tbeddel Tasertit-a n Urrad i wakken ad d-tesken ibeddilen deg usaḍuf azzayri, timahilin n tenfalit, asnerni n tmahilt, tarrayin n useddel n txazabit, neɣ isumaren n yiseqdacen.
policyUpdates.noticeOfChanges: Ibeddilen ixataren (yessenqasen izerfan n useqdac): Alɣu s e-mail 30 n wussan uqbel azemz n tazwara, Alɣu deg usnas, Alɣu deg usebter agejdan. Ibeddilen ur nelli d ixataren: Azemz yettwabeddlen kan.
policyUpdates.acceptanceOfChanges: Aseqdec ikemmlen n Tenfalit deffir uzemz n tazwara yettwaḥseb d aqbal n Tsertit n Urrad tamaynut. Ma ur teqbileḍ ara: Ḥbes aseqdec uqbel azemz n tazwara, Suter urrad i yijerriḍen urmeden, Sseqdec izerfan-ik n umdan.
policyUpdates.grandfatheringProvision: Tiɣin yettwaxedmen uqbel abeddel n tsertit tettwanebḍ s tsertit yellan deg wakud n tiɣin, anagar ma abeddel yettusuter s usaḍuf, yefka aḥerrez yugaren, neɣ qblen iḥricen i sin tiwtilin timaynutin.
